transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Tech support.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Hi, my internet is down.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Account number?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Wait.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Hello? Are you there?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Still looking. What's the problem?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: I already said, the internet is down. It's a flashing red light.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Let me check the system.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Excuse me, it's been over ten minutes. What is happening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Yeah.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: This is terrible service. Let me speak to a supervisor right now.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: A manager can't do anything for you. Just wait.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: I don't care, I want a manager! Transfer me!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: No. They are busy.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: If you don't get me a manager, I am cancelling my service today! I swear!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Whatever. Let me try pressing a reset button.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Hello?! Have you fixed it yet?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Did it work?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Did what work? You didn't tell me what you were doing. The light is still red.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Unplug it.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: The power cord?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Yes.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Okay, I unplugged it.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Plug it back in.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Okay, it's plugged in. Still red.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Yeah, my button didn't work. The system is broken.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Is anyone there?! I have been on this call for almost 30 minutes!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Yeah, I'm here.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: So what is the actual solution here?!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Looks like there's an outage in your area. Nothing I can do.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: An outage? Why didn't you tell me that 30 minutes ago?!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Didn't look at the map until now.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Get me a manager immediately! I am cancelling my account right now!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Managers don't take these calls. You just have to call back tomorrow when the outage is over.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: I am NOT calling back tomorrow. You need to fix this right now or I am gone!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Can't fix an outage. Just call back tomorrow.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Don't you dare hang up on me--

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Bye.
